# ESM Model Decision Tree

Use this interactive guide to find the right ESM model for your project.

---

## 1. What's your primary goal?

:::{.decision-tree}

### A. I need protein sequence representations or embeddings

**→ Go to Section 2A**

### B. I want to design or generate protein sequences

**→ Go to Section 2B**

### C. I need to predict 3D protein structures

**→ Go to Section 2C**

### D. I want to understand or score protein mutations

**→ Go to Section 2D**

:::

---

## 2A. Sequence Representations & Embeddings

### What's your use case?

**I'm doing research and want the best representations**
→ **Use ESMC** (latest, best quality, metagenomic training)
- [Model Card](https://biohub.ai/models/esmc)
- [Tutorial: Getting Embeddings](https://biohub.ai/resources/tutorials)
- [GitHub](https://github.com/Biohub/esm)

**I have existing ESM2 code and want to upgrade**
→ **Use ESMC** (drop-in replacement, but see migration guide)
- [Migration Guide](../use-cases/model-development.qmd#esm2-migration)
- [Comparison Table](model-comparison.qmd)

**I'm using legacy code tied to ESM2**
→ **Stay with ESM2** (for now)
- [ESM2 Docs](https://huggingface.co/facebook/esm2)
- Plan migration to ESMC when ready

**I want to fine-tune on my own data**
→ **Use ESMC**
- [Fine-tuning Tutorial](https://biohub.ai/resources/tutorials)
- Larger models (6B) work best, but 300M is faster for experiments

**I need this to be very fast**
→ **Use ESMC-300M**
- Smallest model, still high quality
- Much faster inference than larger models

---

## 2B. Protein Design & Generation

### What do you want to design?

**De novo proteins (completely new sequences)**
→ **Use ESM3**
- [Model Card](https://biohub.ai/models/esm3)
- [Design Tutorial](https://biohub.ai/resources/tutorials)
- [Paper](https://www.science.org/doi/10.1126/science.adk2211)

**Protein binders (antibodies, miniproteins)**
→ **Use ESM3 with ESMFold2**
- Generate sequences with ESM3
- Validate structures with ESMFold2
- [Binder Design Example](../use-cases/model-applications.qmd#antibody-engineering)

**Enzyme variants (improving existing proteins)**
→ **Use ESMC + ESMFold2**
- Score mutations with ESMC embeddings
- Validate with structure prediction
- [Directed Evolution Example](../use-cases/model-applications.qmd#directed-evolution)

---

## 2C. Structure Prediction

### What type of structure do you need?

**Single protein chain (monomers)**
→ **Use ESMFold2-Fast**
- Fastest option
- Excellent accuracy
- [Tutorial](https://biohub.ai/resources/tutorials)

**Protein complexes (antibody-antigen, PPIs, multimers)**
→ **Use ESMFold2**
- State-of-the-art accuracy
- Handles up to 768 residues (all chains combined)
- [Complex Prediction Tutorial](https://biohub.ai/resources/tutorials)

**Large complexes (>768 residues)**
→ **Use ESMFold2-Fast on individual chains, then dock manually**
- Or use [Docking Tools](../use-cases/model-applications.qmd)
- Future versions may support longer sequences

**I need maximum accuracy**
→ **Use ESMFold2 with MSA**
- Request on [Biohub](https://biohub.ai)
- 3-5% better accuracy with multiple sequence alignment

**I need to screen thousands of structures quickly**
→ **Use ESMFold2-Fast**
- 1.3x faster than ESMFold2
- Minimal accuracy trade-off

---

## 2D. Mutation Scoring & Variant Effects

### What's your goal?

**Predict effects of all possible mutations (variant effect prediction)**
→ **Use ESMC with log-likelihood ratios**
- [Mutation Scoring Tutorial](https://biohub.ai/resources/tutorials)
- [Variant Prediction Example](../use-cases/model-applications.qmd#disease-variant-prediction)

**Find stabilizing mutations for protein engineering**
→ **Use ESMC + ESMFold2**
- Score with ESMC
- Validate stability with structure
- [Stability Engineering Example](../use-cases/model-applications.qmd)

**Understand disease-causing mutations**
→ **Use ESMC**
- [Disease Prediction Tutorial](https://biohub.ai/resources/tutorials)
- Compare wild-type vs. mutant log-likelihood

**Protein function prediction**
→ **Use ESMC**
- Function information in layer 50-60
- [Function Prediction Example](../use-cases/model-applications.qmd)

---
